items.text: Malik Nabers (knee) ACTIVE for SNF vs Cowboys after murky game-time decision; family didn't even travel as he was unsure until ~2 hours pre-kick. Berry starts despite decoy risk.
items.why: Player decision; elevated practice squad WRs as contingency.
items.implication: Start with risk of limited snaps/decoy.
items.opportunity: High target share if fully engaged; watch snap counts.

items.text: Jeremiyah Love (ankle) expected to play and later confirmed ACTIVE for Cardinals Week 1. Berry starts him everywhere as risk/reward RB2.
items.why: Weekend reports and official active; team not worried about injury enough to hold.
items.implication: Start as RB2 with upside in Cards offense.
items.opportunity: Primary RB snaps/carries if healthy enough for full role.

items.text: Rome Odunze (calf) expected to play; Schefter confirms officially ACTIVE for Bears Week 1.
items.implication: Viable WR start in Bears offense.
items.opportunity: Routes and targets as primary WR.

items.text: Alvin Kamara (knee) not expected to play and confirmed inactive/OUT for Saints Week 1 vs Lions. Affects Etienne projection heavily.
items.why: Full practice late week but not ready; Saints ease him in, expected Week 2.
items.implication: Sit; Etienne becomes clear lead back.
items.opportunity: Full RB1 workload to Travis Etienne; Kendre Miller RB2.

items.text: Zay Flowers (hamstring) left early; not serious, day-to-day, MRI upcoming. Would have returned if playoff game.
items.why: Hamstring not considered serious per sources.
items.implication: Monitor practice; possible Week 2 sit risk.
items.opportunity: If out, boost to Likely and other BAL pass-catchers.

items.text: Starting Malik Nabers everywhere post-ACTIVE despite decoy risk.
items.why: Active and talent outweigh limited/decoy concerns.

items.text: Ja'Kobi Lane (wrist) ruled OUT; initial diagnosis fractured wrist, several weeks, further MRI. Ravens lose promising rookie WR.
items.why: Fracture confirmed in game; multi-week absence.
items.implication: Stash if deep; Ravens WR depth thins with Flowers also dinged.
items.opportunity: More targets to Flowers (if healthy), Likely, others.

items.text: Jeremiyah Love ACTIVE: risk/reward RB2 but start everywhere. Cards wouldn't activate if major concern.
items.why: Active status signals confidence; upside in offense.

items.text: AJ Brown (high ankle sprain) out 4-6 weeks, no surgery needed. Patriots WR sidelined.
items.why: High ankle sprain confirmed; timeline 4-6 weeks.
items.implication: Long-term sit; look for NE WR handcuffs/waivers.
items.opportunity: Increased targets to other Patriots WRs.

items.text: Brock Bowers (knee, meniscus trim) OUT Week 1 but realistic chance return Week 2 vs Chargers; Raiders optimistic short absence.
items.why: Post-surgery recovery tracking well for potential quick return.
items.implication: Hold; monitor practice this week. Short-term TE streamer needed.
items.opportunity: Michael Mayer or other LV TEs elevated short-term.

items.text: Main slate news locked except murky Nabers (resolved active); combined injury wave includes Bowers (knee), AJ Brown (ankle), plus post-game Flowers/McConkey exits. Not a clean start. Projections updating live; Kamara status lifts Etienne.
items.why: Player-specific status/projection focus; no other major changes expected.
items.implication: Adjust lineups/projections for absences and beneficiaries.
items.opportunity: Etienne full load; watch post-game for Flowers/McConkey Week 2.

items.text: Isaiah Likely breakout season well underway after strong Week 1 showing.
Buy low on Colston Loveland; preseason belief in Bears offense unchanged despite Week 1 weirdness/targets to Kmet/Raymond.
items.why: Wants Bears offense share; Week 1 not indicative.
items.implication: Trade target or hold for bounceback.

items.text: Dontayvion Wicks role more real than not after preseason hype with new OC Sean Mannion (from Packers).
items.why: Preseason talk confirmed by early usage.
items.implication: Waiver/ depth chart riser in PHI.
